categories.main_business_segments: The company focuses on three primary business segments: intelligent cockpit systems, intelligent driving systems, and connected services. These segments encompass integrated intelligent hardware and advanced software algorithms to provide safe, comfortable, and efficient mobile travel solutions globally. The intelligent cockpit segment includes smart interaction systems, display hardware, domain controllers, and computing solutions. The intelligent driving segment offers advanced driving computing systems, sensors, and algorithms. Connected services focus on in-vehicle software development and operational services to build comprehensive vehicle networking ecosystems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as AI-driven autonomous driving algorithms, optical technologies for vehicle displays, vehicle network communication, cybersecurity, and OTA updates. Manufacturing employs intelligent processes including fully automated OCR/OCA lamination lines for various screen sizes and types, SMT patching, LCM display module production, domain controller manufacturing, automotive-grade SIP production, and high-automation millimeter-wave radar production. The company integrates MES, WMS, ELM, ERP, and APS systems for digitalized and lean manufacturing, emphasizing zero-defect SMT processes and advanced testing capabilities including radar and intelligent driving scenario simulations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a broad customer base including major domestic independent brands such as Li Auto, Chery, Geely, GAC Aion, Great Wall, XPeng, BYD, SAIC, and international OEMs like Volkswagen, Audi, Stellantis, SEAT, Skoda, Volvo, Mazda, Tata Motors, and Caterpillar. The markets covered include passenger vehicles with a focus on electric and intelligent vehicles. The company has expanded into high-end domestic and international markets, including Europe, Southeast Asia, Japan, North America, and India.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales cover primarily China (domestic market) with significant international presence in Europe (Germany, Sweden), North America (USA, Mexico), Southeast Asia (Indonesia, India), Japan, and Singapore. The company has established R&D centers and manufacturing facilities in these regions, including new plants in Europe and Mexico and R&D centers in Japan and China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the automotive electronics supply chain, focusing on front-end automotive electronics manufacturing and software development for OEMs. It provides pre-installed (front-mounted) automotive electronic components and integrated intelligent systems directly to vehicle manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening intelligent vehicle integration through intelligent cockpit and driving domain fusion, expanding connected services, and accelerating internationalization. R&D focuses on high-performance intelligent cockpit solutions, multi-configuration intelligent driving domain controllers, vehicle networking ecosystems, and intelligent access systems using BLE, UWB, NFC, 4G/5G technologies. The company invests heavily in AI, cybersecurity, and software lifecycle management, maintaining over 3,800 R&D staff and investing over 2 billion RMB annually in R&D.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of automotive electronic components and integrated intelligent systems to OEMs. The company operates mainly in the front-installation business model, selling hardware and software solutions. Connected services also contribute through software development and operational services, but the core remains product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading automotive electronics supplier in China and globally, ranked 89th in the global top 100 automotive parts suppliers. It competes with other major automotive electronics suppliers in intelligent cockpit and driving systems, maintaining leadership through technology innovation, quality, and comprehensive product portfolios. It has won multiple awards from domestic and international OEMs, including Toyota and Audi, reflecting strong competitive positioning.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company achieved revenues of approximately 21.9 billion RMB in 2023, representing a 46.7% year-over-year increase, with a compound annual growth rate of 47.7% from 2020 to 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders reached 1.547 billion RMB, up 30.6% year-over-year. The company has sustained double-digit revenue growth for four consecutive years and expanded its order backlog to over 24.5 billion RMB in annualized sales. It employs over 8,500 staff with a strong R&D team constituting 45% of total employees.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes comprehensive, integrated intelligent vehicle solutions combining hardware and software to enhance safety, comfort, and efficiency in mobility. It differentiates through advanced AI algorithms, high-performance computing platforms, and leading-edge manufacturing capabilities including zero-defect processes and extensive testing facilities. Its global R&D and manufacturing footprint, strong customer relationships, and commitment to quality and sustainability underpin its competitive advantage. The company also leads in industry standards and cybersecurity certifications, reinforcing its position as a trusted partner in the automotive intelligent transformation.
